escalations.title: Vitest UI Arbitrary File Read & Code Execution
escalations.detail: When Vitest UI server is listening, attackers can read arbitrary files and execute code without authentication. Direct dependency in Portal projects.

escalations.title: Protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution (transitive via gRPC)
escalations.detail: Arbitrary code execution via protobufjs pulled transitively through OpenTelemetry gRPC exporters in Portal/Backend.

escalations.title: Tinypool Prototype Pollution → Remote Code Execution (2 CVEs)
escalations.detail: Two prototype pollution gadgets in tinypool (transitive via vitest) allow RCE when worker options are attacker-controlled. Affects all projects using vitest.

escalations.title: Proxy-Addr IPv4-mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing — Access Control Bypass
escalations.detail: IP spoofing via IPv4-mapped IPv6 bypass breaks req.ip trust logic in Express. Any rate limiting or access-control logic that trusts req.ip can be circumvented.
escalations.fix: npm update proxy-addr in Source/Backend and portal/Backend

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion
escalations.detail: Type confusion in AST processing allows JavaScript injection by tampering @partial-block, breaking Handlebars template sandboxing.

p1_findings.title: PostCSS Arbitrary File Read via sourceMappingURL (CVSS 7.5)
Vite server.fs.deny Bypass on Windows Alternate Paths (CVSS 7.5)

p1_findings.detail: 4 additional critical CVEs in portal/Backend beyond protobufjs — full detail in dependency-audit-2026-10-21.md DEP-010 through DEP-013

p2_findings.title: FR-dependency-* in Source/ misattributes portal/ system spec IDs
p2_findings.detail: Source/ dependency subsystem borrows portal/ FR IDs with no spec of its own — traceability enforcement for dependency subsystem is semantically meaningless.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add new plan section under Plans/dependency-linking/ targeting Source/ paths, or add explicit scope clarification note.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers directly access workItemStore (bypasses service layer)
p2_findings.detail: CLAUDE.md rule: no direct store calls from route handlers. All three route files call store.createWorkItem(), store.findAll(), etc. directly. Business logic is embedded in handlers.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract store interactions into workItemService.ts; route handlers call service functions only.

p2_findings.title: Silent JSON parse error suppression in api/client.ts (.catch(() => ({})))
p2_findings.detail: JSON parse failures in the API client are silently swallowed with no log or comment. Violates CLAUDE.md 'never swallow errors silently' rule.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add comment explaining intent, optionally log parse error at debug level.

p2_findings.title: 65 high-severity CVEs across Source/ and Portal/ (bulk)
p2_findings.recommendation: Run npm audit fix and targeted npm update per dependency-audit-2026-10-21.md remediation plan. See ranked fix list.
